# rtorrent-mcp

BitTorrent client management MCP server — rTorrent XML-RPC, torrent search (nyaa, piratebay, annas-archive), media integration (Plex/Jellyfin), legal compliance.

## Tools

- `torrent_management` (13 ops): add, list, pause, resume, delete, status, check completed, media notify
- `search_management` (13 ops): anime, manga, movies, TV shows, ebooks, comics, IMDb, TVDB
- `system_management` (5 ops): health, status, info, analyze, help
- `workflow_management` (8 ops): franchise download, batch series, queue, schedule
- `nlp_management` (3 ops): natural language command parsing
- `legal_management` (4 ops): Austrian copyright compliance check
- `agentic_rtorrent_workflow`: LLM-orchestrated multi-step (requires Ollama)

## Ports

- Backend: 10910 (MCP HTTP `/mcp` + REST `/api/*`)
- Frontend: 10911 (Vite dev)
